name: Files
description: Tabbed file viewer with multiple viewer types per tab. V4 added per-type icons + copy-path button in the Ctrl+P picker. See docs/files-applet-v4.md.

agentUsage.purpose: Tabbed file viewer with per-tab viewer switching. Default viewer is markdown for .md files, image for binary images, html for .html, and diff for everything else. A floating button toggles between viewers when more than one applies. Ctrl+P opens the fuzzy file picker.
